name: PGC 12562 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 12562, a small galaxy with fast-moving central stars, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc12562-hubble
story: A small galaxy whose stars move remarkably fast, hinting at a black hole heavier than a galaxy its size should hold. Hubble imaged it to resolve its compact central bulge and pin down that black hole's mass.

claims.text: PGC 12562 was a target of Hubble program 13050, The Most Massive Black Holes in Small Galaxies
The program's targets are galaxies with extremely high velocity dispersions and very small sizes
Hubble imaging was to resolve their small bulges and constrain their black hole masses
